opening.argument: The video directs viewers to create a StrongBlock node and presents node participation as a route to passive income. Its title promises “Earn passive income with strongblock nodes.” The speaker provides operational steps: “Log on to StrongBlock Click create a node Name your node and give it a description.” The displayed creation terms require a non-refundable, non-returnable contribution of 10 STRONG, while the node dashboard indicates that failing to pay a monthly fee within 30 days may result in automatic node removal. The income opportunity is therefore tied to a financial commitment and may involve recurring fees, rather than being presented as cost-free earnings.
